element: Apple / Google / X / Snapchat sign-in on the web
found: [owner] Web shows Google only when a client id is set; Apple (Services ID, return URL) and X/Snapchat need provider setup the web does not have. POST /auth/social-login exists in the backend.
suspect: Buttons would be fake without provider credentials; owner to supply ids/flags.

element: resend countdown 300 s vs 60 s in the app
found: [backend] POST /auth/otp/request is throttled to 3 per 10 minutes, so the web waits 300 s; the app waits 60 s and would hit 429 after 3 sends.
suspect: Reviewer to decide one cooldown and one throttle for both clients.

element: password minimum disagrees across app (6), web (8) and backend (10)
found: [backend] backend MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH is 10 (password-security.service.ts:22); the web register/reset forms say 8 and the app 6, so valid-looking passwords are rejected by the server.
suspect: One rule across app, web and backend.

element: register creates the account before the OTP step
found: [backend] app sends OTP first; backend flow on web is register then OTP (?sent=0 leaves an account without a code).
suspect: Flow is backend-defined; not changed by design session.

element: no OTP-based reset on the web
found: [backend] app goes forgot -> OTP -> reset with the code; web POST /auth/password/forgot mails a reset token the person types on /password-reset.
suspect: Needs an OTP reset endpoint the web can call.

element: after sign-in always /dashboard, no role check or provider-info page
found: [owner] app sends non-patient roles to provider-info; web has no such page.
suspect: Owner to decide whether the web needs it.

element: whole page becomes an error state when a call fails
found: [owner] audit asks for a retry banner; the 2026-10-06 owner rule says ErrorState with retry when there is no cached copy.

element: no app version on the web
found: [owner] the web has no build version string to show; confirm whether a build id should be exposed.
suspect: Needs an owner choice of what the version is.

element: kinds and PATCH body differ from the app
found: [backend] web sends {group:{key:value}} (categories/channels); app sends flat flags (7 kinds incl. locked emergency). Both must edit the same stored settings.
suspect: Backend DTO to confirm both shapes or unify.

element: unread dot on the notification bell
found: [backend] the backend notifications controller has no unread-count endpoint and the proxy allowlist has none; the bell cannot show a dot without an extra request per page.
suspect: Backend to add GET /notifications/unread-count; the home keeps one session request per page by design (F82).

found: [owner] the app keeps a device-only preference read by its date helpers; the web formatters (lib/format-date) do not read one, so a switch would do nothing.
suspect: Owner to decide if the web shows Hijri dates, then wire lib/format-date first.

element: sort, filter sidebar, pharmacies tab, price cards
found: [backend] GET /search takes q, locale and limit only and returns no price or sale fields.
suspect: Needs backend filter/sort params before the board's sidebar can be wired.

found: [owner] /drug-scanner is an app screen (camera); no web equivalent exists.
suspect: Owner to decide if the web needs a scan flow.

found: [client] no web map component for choosing a point exists; set-default is done.
suspect: Needs the map component (shared with delivery address) before the picker.

found: [backend] the Patient Contract V1 register takes one identifier; the app sends email and phone together (legacy payload).
suspect: Backend to confirm one contract for both clients.

found: [backend] GET /users/me/sessions sends a masked IP, not a place; the row shows the masked IP.
suspect: Backend to add a coarse location if the owner wants it.
